title: Edge call slim format experiment
content:
Purpose: sketch a minimal HTTP/JSON wire format for edge clients to send compact LLM requests to a local proxy (or direct to Redwood gateway) with small-bandwidth telemetry plus deterministic resume semantics. Goal is ~200B payloads for mobile and IoT while preserving enough metadata for routing, cost accounting, and safe retrying.

Constraints / goals:
- Keep request envelope small (prefer short header keys, avoid deep nesting).
- Allow streaming tokens or chunked bodies without complex framing on client.
- Idempotency and resume: support lightweight sequence tokens for resumable streams.
- Telemetry: sample-level labels (route, model-hint, cached-prefix-hit) but minimal.
- No heavy crypto on path; auth remains standard bearer.

High-level envelope (informal):
- method: "call" | "chat" | "embed"
- model: short alias (e.g., "rwd-7b-opt")
- seq_id: short base36 id per conversation (idempotency/resume key)
- tx: integer token counter (client-provided incremental)
- preface_hash: optional small fingerprint of client-provided context prefix (8-12 hex) used by proxy for quick cache lookup
- prompt: optionally omitted if preface_hash present and proxy has cached prefix
- opts: tiny flags bitmask (streaming, need_attention_scores, safe_mode)
- telemetry: comma-delimited code string (e.g., "r:us-west-1,m:pr-95,c:pfhit")

Example minimal JSON (single chunk request):
{
  "method":"call",
  "model":"rwd-7b-opt",
  "seq_id":"k9fz1",
  "tx":42,
  "preface_hash":"e3a7c1b2",
  "opts":"s",
  "telemetry":"r:usw,m:pr95,c:1",
  "prompt":"summarize: current design doc..."
}

Streaming chunk model: client opens a POST and sends small JSON chunks separated by LINE-FEED (\n). Each chunk matches the same minimal envelope but with prompt omitted after first chunk; subsequent chunks have type: "cont" and include "tx" increments. Server echoes resume-ack messages as short single-line JSON with seq_ack and highest_tx seen. This keeps the wire human-readable and very easy to proxy.

Resume semantics:
- Client reconnects with same seq_id and tx = last_ack + 1. Proxy checks consistency via preface_hash and model alias. If mismatch, proxy replies with error code "resync_needed" and includes last_known_tx and optional small diff-hint.
- For safety, backend only honors resume within a sliding window (default 30s/5 chunks) unless client has persisted session token.

Failure modes / backoff:
- transient network -> client exponential backoff with jitter; save last sent tx locally for resume window.
- model fallback -> proxy sets telemetry flag "f:variant" when it routes to cheaper variant; client records but continues.
- cache-miss on resume -> treat as resync_needed.

Telemetry compact codes (proposal):
- r:<region short> (usw, use, euw)
- m:<route-ish> (p=primary, b=burst, pr95=perf tier)
- c:<cache> (0|1)
- f:<fallback> present if fallback used
- s:<sample_rate> optional sample token e.g., s:1/100
These are concatenated with commas to keep the telemetry field tiny.

Client local caching policy (proxy-friendly):
- keep prefix cache keys for preface_hash -> prefix text and KV-cache hints (e.g., last_kv_size).
- prefer cache-positive fast-path: if proxy responds 200 + code "served_from_preface" then client clears local duplicate prompt.

Server-side routing interactions (notes for proxy impl):
- resolve model alias -> pick exact variant; annotate response with "model_actual" short alias and telemetry fwd.
- if prefetched KV hit, set header "X-RW-PrefHit:1" and include short kv_age (seconds).

Security / privacy notes:
- preface_hash must be non-reversible (use truncated blake2s of prefix + salt) to avoid leaking client context in logs.
- telemetry field is non-sensitive; never include user PII.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Agree on seq_id length & encoding (base36 vs base62) and collision model for long-lived clients.
- How to encode multi-turn history compactly (slot references vs full text) if clients have poor connectivity.
- Formal retry semantics when streaming partial output already delivered to user. Do we dedupe on tx or accept duplicates?
- Integrate this with console observability: how to expose compact telemetry as facets in traces.

Next steps:
- quick prototype in rw-proxy branch (linked PR). Implement chunked line-delimited JSON parsing and resume ACK path.
- lightweight integration tests: mobile emulator with flaky network to validate resume window.
- sync with privacy team regarding preface_hash salt rotation policy.

Notes-to-self: keep API intentionally ugly and short for first iteration; we can expand with proper schema once field names stabilize.

References: internal PR + ENG ticket linked above. Also consider borrowing bits from earlier "prefetch-credit-ledger-journal" patterns but keep independent.
